correctness.rationale: For a uniform 3-color configuration, each oriented subdivided path has increments in {-1,0,1}, with modular cycle sums zero. The chord block of a fundamental-cycle matrix gives full modular surjectivity, so conditioning independent increments costs precisely 3^r, not 1. Closed color-flow balance implies the CCA signed integral is 3 times the GHM one. Gravner–Lyu–Sivakoff Theorem 3 equates synchronization with zero cycle integrals; hence the exact finite convolution formula. For fixed H, lattice Fourier inversion with covariance (2L/3) B diag(ell) B^T, full Z^r lattice and aperiodicity gives local mass (3/(4πL))^{r/2}/sqrt(det Q), multiplied by 3^r. The cographic Cauchy–Binet identity makes det Q the weighted co-tree polynomial. Independently enumerated all uniform colorings of cycles of lengths 3..9 and compared with lazy-step exact central counts including multiplier 3; finite tests do not prove the general result.
